title: Church music in Steubenville and Los Angeles; cousin Gladys Scippio
summary: Howard's father and uncle directed the AME choir in Steubenville; in Los Angeles he played cornet at an AME church with cousin Gladys on piano.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: And, according to this article, your father and your uncle directed the choir in the Steubenville church.
Did you sing in the choir? Ever?
No, I don't think I did. I might have. (laughter) I don't remember--it's gone by so. It's gone by so fast.
And I believe--also, on the tape that you did with Buddy and Red Callender before, you mentioned something about when you came to California and you were playing in the churches here. Right?
Nothin'. Just played in church, that's all.
Well, did you play all of your instruments? You came here with a cornet and saxophone and clarinet--
The cornet, in the church here.
I didn't play all that--just the cornet.
And I think, on the other tape, that you mentioned the names of some of the pieces that you played in church here. Or else, you mentioned the name of the book that you played from. Do you remember?
I'm afraid I can't remember the titles, either, but--seemed like I heard that on that other tape.
I thought I--seems like I remembered you talking about--
You thought of a name--came up with a name--it was hard to do--(inaudible) do you remember some of the pieces you played?
It's kinda hard for me to do now. I can't even think of nothin' (laughter)
What church was it here in Los Angeles?
AME. Was there a whole band, or a choir and just a few instruments?
Were there other musicians playing, too, or just you playing solos or what?
I had a cousin in there playing with me.
Her name was Gladys. I can't think of Gladys' last name now. She's passed on and gone. But I can't think of her last name. Gladys--
The whole family was musical--just everywhere.

Yeah, all around. Even--oh, Buddy, you know--even to what's-er-name--the people who had--oh, Susie's family--they all sang and--everybody sang. She played piano and, you know, most all the things--organ--and piano. My cousin, Gladys.
Oh. How do you spell Cipio?
S-c--p-p-i-o, yes, she can spell it.
So, did you play regularly in the church, for quite a while?
